summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph. It uses a nested add_to_cbd helper: step (a) adds subject triples and recurses into blank-node objects with no subject triples in the result yet; step (b) adds all triples of every reifier whose rdf:subject is the node. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (testCbd, testCbdReified, testCbdReifiedUntypedIncluded, testCbdIncomingReificationExcluded, testCbdBlankNodeNotExpandedThroughReification, testCbdBlankNodeCycle, testCbdSourceUnchanged). Tests were not run, per instructions; expected counts were checked by hand: R1 8, R2 3, R3 2, R4 0, R5 8, R6 13, A 5, B 0, R7 5, R8 4. Nothing committed.
